data.description: The figure provides detailed information about a secondary cement job in the original wellbore section of Well 56-32. The job started on March 4, 2021, at 1:30 PM with one attempt to remediate using zone breakdown pressure. Slurry information includes two types: SPACER and CLASSC, with densities of 8.43 lbs/gal and 15.60 lbs/gal respectively. The post-job information indicates that the job was successful (Yes) as no cement top was observed at the surface by 22:00 hours.
